name: Steam Grid DB API
tagline: Community artwork for Steam grids, heroes, logos, and icons
description: Steam Grid DB provides a community-driven artwork API for game grids, heroes, logos, and icons used by custom launchers, skins, and Steam library tools. Developers can search games and fetch high-quality assets with filtering by style, dimension, and type.

auth.details: API key via Authorization: Bearer header; self-serve from profile preferences after login

use_cases: search games by name for artwork matching
download grid covers for a Steam AppID
fetch hero banners for a launcher theme
get logos and icons for game library skins
